profile.description: 一定要定比跟单！否则容易爆仓！ 保证金至少50U、不要选择本人已开仓位立即开仓，否则容易爆仓！跟完躺平就好，  回撤大很正常，但绝不会放任爆仓。跟单想挣钱，翻一两倍就要提利润走，我也会有错的时候。
profile.descTranslate: Always copy trades! Otherwise, you risk a margin call! Your margin must be at least 50 USDT. Do not immediately open a position based on someone else's existing trades, as this can also lead to a margin call! Once you've copied my trades, just relax and wait. Large drawdowns are normal, but I will never allow a margin call to happen. If you're copying trades and want to make money by doubling or tripling your investment, you're not going to stop now. I make mistakes too.
